entities.name: Ketria
entities.description: A blue-aligned triome region of Ikoria with forests, rivers and abundant mana crystals.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane on which Ketria lies.

entities.name: Lake Attayal
entities.description: The largest known freshwater body on Ikoria, fed by the Tal River.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who encountered Rielle at Lake Attayal.

entities.name: Rielle
entities.description: A reclusive sage known for her longevity and understanding of Ikoria's magic.

entities.name: Jal Korcha
entities.description: Monumental road across Ikoria, passing along the border of Lake Attayal.

entities.name: The Quartzwood
entities.description: A subregion of Ketria, an ancient forest dense with crystals.

entities.name: Tal River
entities.description: A vital waterway of Ketria emptying into Lake Attayal.

entities.name: Elemental clade
entities.description: The dominant clade of monsters in Ketria, manifestations of natural elements.

entities.name: Illuna
entities.description: The apex monster of Ketria, a massive elemental.

entities.name: Raugrin
entities.description: Another Ikorian triome region connected by Jal Korcha.

entities.name: Savai
entities.description: Another Ikorian triome region connected by Jal Korcha.

events.summary: Vivien Reid meets the sage Rielle at Lake Attayal.
events.quote: This is also the site where Vivien Reid encountered Rielle

relations.quote: Ketria is one of the three-color triome regions found on the plane of Ikoria .
Within Ketria, it passes along the border of Lake Attayal.
The apex monster of Ketria is Illuna
